title: Frieren staff — remade joint, removable head
description: Only the staff arrived — the head had broken off with studs stuck inside, and a prior epoxy fix had failed. We rebuilt the joint with a tiny bolt and shaped nut so the staff head is removable again, as requested.
itemDetails: This is the signature mage staff accessory from Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End figure releases — a slender maroon shaft with a gold-finished head, central red gem in a circular frame, and red binding detail. Matching staffs ship with several official lines, including Good Smile Company Nendoroid Frieren and other scale / articulated figure releases of the character. Only the staff was sent for repair (not the full figure). Construction is painted plastic typical of anime figure accessories; the fragile neck between shaft and head is a common break point when the peg or stud shears inside the socket.
repairDetails: The client posted only the staff. The head had broken away with the studs still stuck inside the staff head, and an earlier epoxy repair had failed. We shaped a tiny nut into a square, drilled the staff head and cut a matching square recess, then epoxy-set the nut in place. The shaft was hand-drilled, the bolt head was cut off, and the bolt stud was epoxy-fixed into the staff. Once cured, the head screws on and off — a removable staff head, as requested.

googleReview.quote: Very good communication with clients and work quickly.
